about: Questions with a known correct answer, for measuring NL-to-SQL accuracy with run_gold_test.php. 'sql' is the reference query; its result must be contained in the generated query's result (extra columns are fine). 'ordered': row order matters. 'expect': 'no_data' means the store does not record this data and the AI must say so instead of querying an unrelated table. Placeholders: {TODAY_FROM} {TODAY_TO} {LAST30_FROM} {MONTH_FROM} {MONTH_TO} {LAST_MONTH_FROM} {YEAR_FROM} {YEAR_TO} {LAST_YEAR_FROM} {OFFSET} {VALID} {STATUS_ATTR} {NAME_ATTR} {LINK}.

cases.question: How many orders have been placed in total, any status?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order

cases.question: What is the total net revenue of all orders, excluding canceled and pending payment orders?
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.base_grand_total - IFNULL(o.base_total_refunded, 0)), 2) FROM sales_order o WHERE {VALID}

cases.question: How many orders are there in each order status?
cases.sql: SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o GROUP BY o.status

cases.question: Which product SKU has sold the most units?
cases.sql: SELECT oi.sku FROM sales_order_item oi JOIN sales_order o ON o.entity_id = oi.order_id WHERE {VALID} AND oi.parent_item_id IS NULL GROUP BY oi.sku ORDER BY SUM(oi.qty_ordered) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many orders of any status were placed in the last 30 days?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.created_at >= '{LAST30_FROM}'

cases.question: What is the average order value, excluding canceled and pending payment orders?
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.base_grand_total), 2) FROM sales_order o WHERE {VALID}

cases.question: Which customer email has the highest total net spend?
cases.sql: SELECT o.customer_email FROM sales_order o WHERE {VALID} GROUP BY o.customer_email ORDER BY SUM(o.base_grand_total - IFNULL(o.base_total_refunded, 0)) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Show net revenue per month for this year, oldest month first.
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.base_grand_total - IFNULL(o.base_total_refunded, 0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_order o WHERE {VALID} AND o.created_at >= '{YEAR_FROM}' AND o.created_at < '{YEAR_TO}' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, '+00:00', '{OFFSET}'), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, '+00:00', '{OFFSET}'), '%Y-%m')

cases.question: How many orders were placed last month (any status)?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.created_at >= '{LAST_MONTH_FROM}' AND o.created_at < '{MONTH_FROM}'

cases.question: How many orders were shipped to each country?
cases.sql: SELECT a.country_id, COUNT(*) FROM sales_order_address a WHERE a.address_type = 'shipping' GROUP BY a.country_id

cases.question: How many orders used each payment method?
cases.sql: SELECT p.method, COUNT(*) FROM sales_order_payment p GROUP BY p.method

cases.question: How many invoices have been created?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_invoice

cases.question: How many credit memos have been issued?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_creditmemo

cases.question: How many registered customers are there?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_entity

cases.question: How many customer emails have placed more than one order, counting orders of any status?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_email FROM sales_order o GROUP BY o.customer_email HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t

cases.question: How many customers are in each customer group? Show the group name.
cases.sql: SELECT g.customer_group_code, COUNT(c.entity_id) FROM customer_entity c JOIN customer_group g ON g.customer_group_id = c.group_id GROUP BY g.customer_group_code

cases.question: How many products are in the catalog?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_product_entity

cases.question: How many products are disabled?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_product_entity_int i WHERE i.attribute_id = {STATUS_ATTR} AND i.store_id = 0 AND i.value = 2

cases.question: How many products have fewer than 100 units in stock?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cataloginventory_stock_item s WHERE s.qty < 100

cases.question: How many products are there of each product type?
cases.sql: SELECT e.type_id, COUNT(*) FROM catalog_product_entity e GROUP BY e.type_id

cases.question: How many product reviews are waiting for approval?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r WHERE r.status_id = 2

cases.question: How many cart price rules are active?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM salesrule r WHERE r.is_active = 1

cases.question: How many coupon codes exist?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM salesrule_coupon

cases.question: How many third-party (non-Magento) modules are installed?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM setup_module m WHERE m.module NOT LIKE 'Magento\_%'

cases.question: Is JavaScript minification enabled?
cases.sql: SELECT c.value FROM core_config_data c WHERE c.path = 'dev/js/minify_files'

cases.question: How many indexers are not valid?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM indexer_state i WHERE i.status <> 'valid'

cases.question: And how many of them are pending?

history.question: How many orders were placed last year, any status?
history.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.created_at >= '{LAST_YEAR_FROM}' AND o.created_at < '{YEAR_FROM}'

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.created_at >= '{LAST_YEAR_FROM}' AND o.created_at < '{YEAR_FROM}' AND o.status = 'pending'
